fichas.title: Stairs: Principles and dimensional requirements
fichas.summary: Guidance on stair stride, slope, riser-to-tread proportions, landings, stair widths, walking lines, handrails, headroom, and stair arrangements. The text notes that applicable national regulations and standards should be consulted; German requirements are cited, and UK guidance includes Approved Document K.
